note: Cumulative build-next ranking. Re-ranked every run. Four sub-scores 1-5: relevance (fit to ecosystem), novelty (new idea vs known), effort_inv (inverted effort, 5=quick win), momentum (market/community signal). composite_score = mean, 2dp. Completed/dropped items retained for history.

items.title: Wrap the Support-Local-Businesses API as an MCP server and publish it to the MCP Registry
items.rationale: SLB has an agent card and a free API but no tool surface, so an agent can discover it and then cannot call it. Run 0004 found the exact shape to copy: hmp-dev/heyyumi-mcp exposes 550k verified venues as a remote MCP with two tools (search, then a booking handoff that returns acceptance). That two-tool pattern maps one-to-one onto /api/v1/businesses plus an email-to-merchant action.
items.run_0004_rationale: Momentum held at 5 and novelty at 5 because HeyYumi supplied a concrete, copyable two-tool shape (search_venues -> request_booking) at the same data scale as SLB; effort stays 3 (server + registry listing + docs).

items.title: Run logly/mureo's /daily-check ad-ops loop against SLB business categories
items.rationale: mureo already implements a daily ad-ops check loop; pointing it at SLB's business categories turns the directory into a service that reports what changed in a local business's ad account each day.
items.run_0004_rationale: Unchanged scores: no new ad-ops repo this run beat mureo, and Gahroot/Komendly adds a generation surface rather than a monitoring loop, so it strengthens rather than replaces this item.

items.title: Replace zdor's LinkedIn scraper with licensed enrichment and write to a CRM the portfolio owns
items.rationale: zdor is the only end-to-end CRM write path and it is 13 months stale with the most legally exposed technique in the corpus. Run 0004 produced both halves of the fix: BAISESYSTEMS/GoHyperLevel as a self-hosted GoHighLevel replacement with an MCP surface, and thkprado/webpilot as a maintained browser driver if scraping must continue.
items.run_0004_rationale: Momentum raised 3->4: two independent run-0004 repos (GoHyperLevel, WebPilot) now address the two halves of this item, so it is no longer blocked on invention.

items.title: Add a two-tier attestation field (self-attested / verified) to SLB listings and publish the criteria
items.rationale: A 6.4M-listing directory has no way to say which records are trustworthy. observer-protocol/at-directory solves exactly this with a self-attested tier plus a verified tier and an explicit statement that the directory stays out of the payment path; inite-ai/inite-visibility supplies the machine-readable half (llms.txt, ai.json, schema graph) that makes a listing legible to agents.
items.run_0004_rationale: New this run: two independent repos converged on attestation tiering for directories, which is the cheapest trust upgrade SLB can ship without re-verifying 6.4M records.

items.title: Stand up GoHyperLevel in Docker and remap zdor's GoHighLevel upsert onto its contacts + pipelines MCP tools
items.rationale: GoHyperLevel is the only repo found in four runs that is simultaneously a system of record, an MCP surface and self-hostable. Migrating zdor's write path to it removes the portfolio's most expensive rented dependency while keeping zdor's duplicate-prevention logic as a pre-write check.
items.run_0004_rationale: New this run. Effort 2 is honest: Docker deployment, 340-tool surface to narrow, and a REST-to-MCP rewrite of the upsert. Momentum 5 because it is actively pushed (2026-11-20) and explicitly positioned as a GoHighLevel alternative.

items.title: Gate each digest run on a signed receipt (atlas.yaml checks + headron verify) instead of a self-assessment paragraph
items.rationale: The run log currently asserts its own coverage and funnel arithmetic. HLIntel/Headron encodes the missing distinction: SKIP and NOT RUN are separate verdicts from PASS, so an unrun check can never be read as a pass. A receipt makes the run log evidence rather than a claim, and it supersedes the vaguer artefact-verified-gates item.
items.run_0004_rationale: New this run, replacing artefact-verified-gates (merged): Headron supplies both the contract format (atlas.yaml) and the CLI that emits PASS/FAIL/SKIP/NOT RUN with a signed receipt.

items.title: Insert a whole-batch preflight between zdor's scrape and its CRM upsert
items.rationale: zdor dedupes per record during the write, so a mid-file failure leaves a half-written batch. founder-sweep/data-quality-gate-examples validates the whole file against a contract with continue/block/warning outcomes before any mutation, and jmamodeo/benchling-toolkit adds the read-only-by-default plus preview-then-apply ladder.
items.run_0004_rationale: New this run. Novelty 3 because zdor already has a duplicate check; what is new is moving it ahead of the write and making it block the whole batch.

items.title: Package marketingskills + awesome-agent-skills as portable Agent Playbook records with bundled scripts
items.rationale: Skills that are text-only break silently the moment they need a script or a credential. matebenyovszky/agentplaybooks bundles scripts into the record; decimal-labs/decimalai-mcp adds the missing ranking signal (measured lift vs a no-skill baseline).
items.run_0004_rationale: Novelty held at 4 but momentum stays 3: DecimalAI and clelp-skills both argue for effectiveness ranking, yet neither publishes a corpus large enough to rank the portfolio's 500 skills.

items.title: Package the GitHub Digest skill itself as a Hermes plugin-catalog entry
items.rationale: The digest is a working agent loop with discovery, scoring, summarisation and state. Packaging it as a plugin entry makes it installable and gives the KB repo a product surface instead of a research surface.
items.run_0004_rationale: Unchanged: egbe-ai/egbe-plugins confirms the skills+connector bundle shape, but no repo this run showed a catalog that would accept the digest as an entry.

items.title: Write a RULES.md prompt payload of the digest's own recurring failure modes and load it into every run
items.rationale: jeffma8888/agent-failure-modes ships 637 real incidents as one-line rules terse enough to drop into a system prompt. The digest's own recurring failures (asserted coverage, unverified writes, regenerating a stale source) are exactly this shape and currently live only in prose lessons.
items.run_0004_rationale: New this run. Effort 5: it is a Markdown file plus one line in the run's system context, and the corpus already exists.

items.title: Model the SLB listing schema as a confirmed ontology so agents can query by intent, not by field name
items.rationale: 6.4M listings with an implicit schema means every agent integration re-derives the same field semantics. An explicit ontology makes the API queryable by intent.
items.run_0004_rationale: Unchanged. Effort stays 2 (highest of any item): the schema has to be confirmed against the live API before it can be published.

items.title: Replace the cron sprawl in self-improving-agent with a single heartbeat that schedules all agent loops
items.rationale: Multiple scheduled loops with no shared scheduler means no ordering, no back-pressure and no single place to see what ran.
items.run_0004_rationale: Unchanged: aeon's GitHub-Actions-as-runtime pattern remains the cheapest implementation, and no run-0004 repo offered a better scheduler.

items.title: Adopt a decision log so rejected candidates and their reasons are queryable, not just tabulated
items.rationale: Every run rejects 350+ candidates with a one-line reason and then forgets them. A decision log makes the screen auditable and lets a later run ask why a repo was rejected.
items.run_0004_rationale: Unchanged. This run's 357 theme rejects are still recorded only as cluster counts, which is the exact gap this item closes.

items.title: Add descriptions and topic tags to the first-party repos that have none, and fix the misnamed ones
items.rationale: Run 0004 found five first-party repos with no description and two with broken names (git-checkout--b-add-new-server, skills---elevenleabs). A repo with no description is invisible to every discovery channel the digest itself uses.
items.run_0004_rationale: Effort confirmed at 5 and evidence strengthened: this run counted five undescribed repos and two misnamed ones, all fixable in one sitting.

items.title: Process run 0004's 31 deferred repos (score >= 3) before searching for new ones
items.rationale: 31 repos already cleared the relevance bar and were cut only by the 30-slot cap. Re-scoring them costs nothing and several (creativeintel, metnos, erkle-ai/cli, omelas-tech/brain) would have made this run's list.
items.run_0004_rationale: Queue refreshed from 20 to 31 entries; the backlog is growing faster than it is being drained, which is itself an argument for draining it first.

items.title: Gate digest run steps on validated artefacts rather than the agent's own completion claim
items.rationale: dynamic-stagegate-harness checks every stage transition against git history, test output or result files — never against the model's claim of completion — and hooks block out-of-state actions instead of warning. Applied here, a digest step would be complete only when its output file validates, which is exactly the failure this run's own JSON block is exposed to (asserted counts vs actual summaries).
items.run_0004_rationale: Merged into digest-receipt-gate: Headron supplies the concrete contract format and CLI that this item only described in the abstract.
